title: Barched + Fresh Animations
description: This is a "Fresh Animations" patch to allow the parched from "barched" to work with the resouce pack animations.
body:
# This pack allows Barched's parched to use "FreshLX" "FA" animations

This pack is meant to be used with FreshLX's "Fresh Animations" and zzik2's "barched"

Make sure to use at least Entity Texture Features 7.1 and Entity Model Features 3.2.2 mods,

**_WARNING: i don't know if optifine supports the resource pack so i dont guarantee it working without bugs_**

and no Fa + Extensions supported for the time being

Modpack makers, feel free to include this pack on your modpack :D


if you see bugs don't hesitate to comment about it.

Thanks to: 
-  FreshLX - Owner of FreshAnimation 
-  zzik2 - Owner of Barched
